papers.title_en: Facultative Swarming: A Capability, Not a Category, for Multi-Robot Systems
papers.evidence: 统一集中式与去中心化多机器人协调的控制框架
papers.tldr: 集体机器人长期被划分为追求最优的集中式多机器人系统与强调鲁棒自组织的去中心化集群，这一边界日益人为。作者提出统一控制框架，把集群能力从“专性”纯自组织转向“兼性”混合架构：条件宽松时集中规划，环境压力下平滑退化为去中心化集群。核心贡献是将集群重述为动态能力而非固定类别，为兼顾集中式最优性与自组织灵活性提供路径。尚未给出实验验证。
papers.abstract_en: Collective robotics is split by a long-standing but increasingly artificial boundary between centralised multi-robot systems that prioritise optimality and decentralised swarms that prioritise robustness and adaptivity. We propose a unified control framework, shifting from `obligate' swarms---systems constrained to pure self-organisation---to facultatively swarming systems: hybrid architectures that operate as centrally planned systems under permissive conditions yet degrade gracefully into decentralised swarming under environmental stress. By reframing swarming as a dynamic capability, rather than a rigid system category, we outline a pathway towards collective robotic systems that benefit from centralised optimality when conditions permit and from the flexibility of self-organisation when they do not.

papers.title_en: Vector-Quantized World Model: Latent Feedback Motion Planning for Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Xuezhou Xu, Chung-Pang Wang, Zhenzhen Li, Benjamin Riviere
papers.evidence: 面向机器人运动规划的向量量化世界模型
papers.tldr: 长程机器人操作受视觉世界模型预测误差累积、搜索复杂和潜在计划难执行困扰。VQ-WM用离散向量量化潜在预测器做长程搜索，再以连续视觉反馈控制器顺序到达计划状态并纠偏。在汉诺塔实机仅用短演示数据达到100%成功率，并在仿真基准上领先强世界模型13.3至85.3个百分点。该框架将离散规划与连续控制结合，支持组合超出演示的长程解。
papers.abstract_en: Visual world models have shown strong potential for robot planning, yet long-horizon manipulation remains challenging due to compounding prediction errors, large search complexity, and latent plans that the low-level controller cannot reliably reach. In this work, we introduce Vector-Quantized World Model (VQ-WM), a latent feedback motion planning framework that integrates discrete long-horizon search with continuous visual feedback control: a discrete latent predictor models transitions between vector-quantized latent states, allowing the planner to look far ahead and find a shortest path to the goal through discrete search and a continuous learned controller sequentially reaches the planned states through visual feedback, correcting deviations to mitigate compounding errors. Whereas most vector quantization uses Euclidean distance, we use a novel estimator of the first-passage-time as a quasi-metric, which aligns the planning abstraction with the controller's capabilities. We evaluate on the physical robot manipulation of the Tower of Hanoi puzzle: whereas existing state-of-the-art foundation models (VLAs, WAMs) only succeed when the solution trace in their training dataset, our method achieves 100\% success rate with only short-play data, demonstrate its ability to compose long-horizon solutions beyond the short demonstrated trajectories and execute them reliably. Our solution also outperforms strongest world-models by 13.3--85.3 percentage points on simulation benchmarks spanning manipulation and locomotion, demonstrating consistent progress and new capabilities.

papers.title_en: CVaR-RMD: CVaR Selection Pressure for Robust Metaheuristic Discovery
papers.evidence: 用于启发式发现的CVaR风险敏感进化框架
papers.tldr: 针对LLM迭代程序搜索发现的启发式算法在均值选择下易忽略稀有严重失败、跨实例族与尺度不稳健的问题，提出CVaR-RMD风险敏感进化框架。该方法让LLM变异可执行启发式程序，并按异质评测条件下的经验条件风险价值排序候选。在三个组合优化领域，它改善尾部性能、降低失败率且均值表现具竞争力。贡献在于将风险度量引入自动启发式发现，并验证了跨更大未见实例与独立基准的泛化性。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have recently been used to discover heuristics through iterative program search, offering a promising approach to automated algorithm design. However, candidates selected by average performance may degrade across instance families, random seeds, and problem scales because mean-based objectives can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose CVaR-RMD, a risk-sensitive evolutionary framework that uses an LLM to mutate executable heuristic programs and ranks candidates by empirical conditional value-at-risk over heterogeneous evaluation conditions. Across three combinatorial optimization domains, CVaR-based selection improves upper-tail performance and reduces failure rates while maintaining competitive mean performance. These gains persist on larger unseen instances and independently curated within-domain benchmarks

papers.title_en: Natural-Language to Nav2: Operational Policies for Costmap-Based Navigation
papers.authors: Jiyeong Chae, Hyunkyo Seo, Heonjae Lee, Kyung-Joon Park
papers.evidence: 面向仓储移动机器人导航的自然语言作业策略与Nav2集成
papers.tldr: 仓库与工业场景中的机器人导航需要随运行条件调整，但传感器只能看到物理障碍，无法表达临时通行规则、路线偏好和例外情况。本文提出自然语言策略接口：本地大模型把操作员指令转成包含目的地、空间约束与时空条件的JSON策略，经确定性校验后，再由三个costmap适配器注入ROS 2 Nav2，并且无需改动规划器和控制器。在150条英文指令上，四个本地模型给出107–142条正确策略，规则解析器仅44条；仿真与TurtleBot3实验中，任务1–3平均用时分别降低18.4–24.5%与23.1–35.0%。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots support material transport in warehouses and industrial facilities, where navigation must adapt to changing operating conditions. Sensor observations reveal physical obstacles, but do not by themselves specify temporary access rules, route preferences, or exceptions known to operators. This paper presents a natural-language policy interface that brings this knowledge into ROS 2 Nav2. A local large language model converts instructions into JSON policies specifying destinations, spatial constraints, and temporal or event conditions. Deterministic checks govern mission acceptance, and three costmap adapters project accepted policies into the existing navigation stack without changing its planner or controller. On 150 researcher-authored English commands, four local models produce 107-142 correct accepted policies, compared with 44 for a rule-based parser, with 3-20 incorrect acceptances per model. Fault injection records rejection of eight endpoint/JSON faults and 29 validator-stage faults. Navigation experiments use correct task policies to evaluate keepouts, zone costs, person-dependent regions, and event-conditioned passage in simulation and on a TurtleBot3. For Tasks 1-3, mean travel times are 18.4-24.5% lower in simulation and 23.1-35.0% lower on the physical testbed than with the baseline lacking those policies. A native KeepoutFilter comparison and two-robot demonstrations examine basic keepout behavior and shared policy projection. The interface connects operator instructions to explicit navigation policies while retaining Nav2's planning and control components.
